body: Last Thursday's rally sent the Sensex up 1,533.72 points (2.11%) to 74,315.61, while the Nifty 50 rose 1.66% to 22,997.35.
Strong quarterly numbers from TCS and HCLTech drove buying in IT and banks. Traders are watching whether the Nifty can hold above 23,000.
dek: TCS and HCLTech results lifted markets as crude eased and the rupee firmed.
title: Sensex jumps 1,500 points on strong IT earnings
coverContext: IT and banks led the rally
